decisions.conflict: The In-Service Agent recommends impact-resistant virgin polymer to ensure durability, whereas the Material and Design Agent recommends a recycled polypropylene monomaterial structure which has lower impact resistance.
espr_constraint: ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (a), page 79: durability and reliability of the product or its components as expressed through resistance to stresses or ageing mechanisms
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (h), page 80: use or content of recycled materials and recovery of materials
decisions.chief_resolution: Recycled polypropylene (rPP) monomaterial structure. To resolve the conflict, the rPP structure will be reinforced with advanced structural ribbing geometry rather than chemical additives, balancing the need for mechanical durability (a) with recycled material content (h) and design for recycling (d).
decisions.design_action: Investigate the technical specifications and mechanical properties of available recycled polypropylene (rPP) grades to confirm if they can meet structural durability requirements without composite reinforcement.

decisions.conflict: The In-Service Agent recommends threaded metal fasteners with brass inserts for robust repairability, whereas the Manufacture Agent rejects this due to increased assembly complexity and the Circularity Agent prefers simple snap-fits and standard screws to avoid multi-material contamination.
espr_constraint: ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (b), page 79: ease of repair and maintenance, including compatibility with commonly available tools and ease of non-destructive disassembly
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (d), page 79: design for recycling, ease and quality of recycling, ease of non-destructive disassembly
decisions.chief_resolution: Reversible mechanical fasteners (screws and snap-fits). This selection avoids chemical adhesives and metal inserts, ensuring ease of disassembly for repair (b) and clean material separation for recycling (d) without introducing substances of concern.
decisions.design_action: Investigate the mechanical feasibility and wear characteristics of standard plastic snap-fits and screws to confirm if they can support repeated disassembly cycles for repair without degradation.

options_evaluated: High-efficiency brushless DC motor with modular, extractable magnets
Demountable motor utilizing remanufactured components and recycled copper windings
decisions.conflict: The In-Service Agent recommends a high-efficiency brushless DC motor to maximize energy efficiency, whereas the Manufacture Agent recommends a magnet-free synchronous reluctance motor to avoid the high environmental footprint of rare-earth mining.
espr_constraint: ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (g), page 79: use or consumption of energy, water and other resources in one or more life cycle stages
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (e), page 79: avoidance of technical solutions detrimental to reuse, upgrading, repair, maintenance, refurbishment, remanufacturing and recycling
decisions.chief_resolution: High-efficiency brushless DC motor with modular, extractable magnets. This choice delivers high in-service energy efficiency (g) and lifetime while using a modular design with non-glued, extractable magnets to facilitate recycling of critical raw materials (e).
decisions.design_action: Verify the availability and supply chain feasibility of brushless DC motors designed with non-glued, mechanically retained magnets to confirm they can be disassembled at end-of-life without specialized industrial equipment.

options_evaluated: Active cooling fan with replaceable dust filters
Passive cooling via integrated aluminum heat sinks
Optimized airflow path using lightweight bio-based heat-conductive polymers
decisions.conflict: The In-Service Agent recommends active fan cooling with replaceable dust filters to maintain operating reliability, whereas the Circularity Agent rejects this due to the generation of consumable filter waste at end-of-life.
espr_constraint: ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (d), page 79: design for recycling, ease and quality of recycling
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (l), page 79: quantity, characteristics and availability of consumables needed for proper use and maintenance
decisions.chief_resolution: Passive cooling via integrated aluminum heat sinks. Passive heat sinks with dry thermal pads eliminate the need for consumable filters (l) and active fan components, reducing waste while providing reliable cooling and easy material separation for recycling (d).
decisions.design_action: Investigate the thermal conductivity and performance specifications of dry thermal pads to confirm if they can maintain safe operating temperatures without active fan cooling.

options_evaluated: Modular architecture with standardized, separable functional blocks
Semi-modular design with soldered wire connections
decisions.conflict: The In-Service and Circularity Agents recommend a fully modular architecture with separable functional cassettes to maximize repairability, whereas the Manufacture Agent recommends a monolithic integrated design to minimize manufacturing energy and waste.
espr_constraint: ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (b), page 79: ease of repair and maintenance, modularity, compatibility with commonly available tools
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (c), page 79: ease of upgrading, reuse, remanufacturing and refurbishment, modularity
decisions.chief_resolution: Modular architecture with standardized, separable functional blocks. A modular architecture is selected because ease of repair (b) and refurbishment (c) are key parameters under ESPR Annex I to prevent premature obsolescence, overriding manufacturing simplicity.
decisions.design_action: Investigate the availability of standardized electrical and mechanical connectors to confirm if they can support a modular cassette architecture without increasing assembly complexity.

options_evaluated: Removable and standardized lithium-ion battery pack
decisions.conflict: The In-Service Agent recommends a removable and standardized lithium-ion battery pack to ensure functional performance and repairability, whereas the Circularity and Manufacture Agents recommend a corded AC power supply to eliminate battery manufacturing impacts and hazardous waste.
espr_constraint: ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (s), page 80: functional performance and conditions for use
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (b), page 79: ease of repair and maintenance, including availability of spare parts
decisions.chief_resolution: Removable and standardized lithium-ion battery pack. A removable and standardized battery pack is selected to ensure functional performance and mobility (s) while addressing the primary failure point of cordless vacuums through easy battery replacement (b).
decisions.design_action: Investigate the availability of standardized, open-source battery pack form factors and communication protocols to confirm if a cross-brand battery standard can be adopted for the vacuum cleaner.
